description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class 'NoteController' for handling CRUD operations on notes. It exposes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes. The class interacts with a 'NoteService' and uses DTOs for request and response payloads, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller class for managing notes, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note using the provided NoteRequest and returns a NoteResponse.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of notes, with optional filters for archived status and search query.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the note matching the specified id with provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the note with the given id.
